principle: reachability and reach-for intent are separated again because their questions and evidence are different.

reachability.answers: can the person reach the target in the current pose?
reachability.method: static_reachability_answer: shoulder-elbow-wrist arm span + object 3D center

reach_for_intent.answers: is the person moving a hand toward an object?
reach_for_intent.method: reach_for_intent: short temporal wrist trajectory + hand-object distance trend
